source_evidence: These plans allow you to buy more shares of a stock you already own by reinvesting dividend payments into the company.
question: Misconception: A dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP) only pays dividends to you in cash and cannot use them to buy more shares.
answer: A DRIP can use dividend payments to buy more shares of a stock you already own. You must sign an agreement with the company for this to happen; check with the company or your brokerage firm about any service charges.
